comment: What :emoji ships that is read as a resource, declared by glob rather than
traced (ADR-0160, ADR-0453).
One font, and it is the one :core's own metadata names as the example of
what a trace misses: 'Inter but neither JetBrains Mono nor OpenMoji --
because the run never switched theme and never drew mono text or an emoji'.
OpenMoji then moved out of :core into this module (ADR-0384) and its
declaration did not move with it, so `assets/fonts/*.ttf` over :core stopped
covering a face that now lives under `emoji/fonts` over :emoji and nothing
covered it at all. The showcase's native image died on the first paragraph
with an emoji in it, three hundred frames into a run that used to stop at
three.
The path is this module's OWN package for the reason ADR-0387 gives: a
resource directory is a package to the module system, so the same font
directory in two modules is one package in two modules and the application
refuses to start. The glob follows the `--root` the asset step is given in
emoji/build.gradle, and DeclaredFontResourceTest holds the two together.
The face is Noto Color Emoji now (ADR-0456); the glob is by directory, so
it covered the new file without changing.
A glob rather than the one name, to match :core's and :widgets's spelling
and because the asset step's output is the authority on what it wrote.
